feature.name: Replace API Key
feature.description: API key was added as an adhoc measure to put additional security for LLM call. It needs to be replaced in two steps. This feature is for step 1.
feature.goal: User should be able to summarise without OpenAI key.

requirements: Remove API key usage from frontend
acceptanceCriteria: API /api/github/summarize should go through OpenAI without user feeding it in request.
